NSU
Novosibirsk State University is an educational institution offering programs in information technology.<SEP>NSU (Novosibirsk State University) is the institution where the FIT faculty is located and where teaching staff are employed.<SEP>NSU is the Novosibirsk State University, an educational institution that provides infrastructure for students.

FIT
The Faculty of Information Technologies is a department within NSU that provides education in computer science and engineering.<SEP>FIT is a faculty that prepares bachelors in informatics and computer engineering, combining fundamental training with practical experience.<SEP>The faculty offering a bachelor's degree program and various student support services.

SBRAS
SBRAS is an institution that maintains professional connections with the FIT faculty.

SberLab-NSU
SberLab-NSU is an educational and scientific laboratory established as a partnership between the university and industry.

SHIFT NSU-CFT
SHIFT NSU-CFT is an educational and scientific laboratory focused on industry-academic collaboration.

PGLab NSU-Postgres Professional
PGLab NSU-Postgres Professional is an educational and scientific laboratory dedicated to database technology research.

Computer Science and Systems Engineering
Computer Science and Systems Engineering is a specialized academic profile offered by the faculty.

Curriculum Topics
Curriculum Topics include software engineering, artificial intelligence, deep machine learning, computer vision, big data analytics, high-performance cluster systems, bioinformatics, and blockchain technologies.

SO RAN
SO RAN (Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences) is a network of research institutes that maintains professional connections with the faculty.

SberLab-NSU Laboratory
A research laboratory established as a partnership between Sber and NSU.

SHIFT NSU-CFT Laboratory
A research laboratory established as a partnership between NSU and CFT.

PGLab NSU-Postgres Professional Laboratory
A research laboratory established as a partnership between NSU and Postgres Professional.

CFT
A partner and employer organization associated with the faculty.

Sber
A partner and employer organization associated with the faculty.

Postgres Professional
A partner and employer organization associated with the faculty.

VK
A partner and employer organization associated with the faculty.

Tinkoff
A partner and employer organization associated with the faculty.

Yandex
A partner and employer organization associated with the faculty.

SibAcademSoft
A partnership of companies that acts as a partner and employer for graduates.

Scholarship Programs
Financial support programs available to first-year students at FIT.

Bachelor's Degree
The academic program level offered by FIT.

IVT
Informatics and Computer Engineering is an academic field of study offered as a bachelor's program at FIT NSU.

FIT NSU
The Faculty of Information Technologies at Novosibirsk State University, which offers a bachelor's degree program.

KNIS
Computer Science and System Engineering is a specialization profile within the IVT program.

PIiKN
Software Engineering and Computer Science is a specialization profile within the IVT program.

09.03.01 Informatics and Computer Engineering
This is the official code and name of the bachelor's degree program offered by FIT NSU.

Novosibirsk State University
Novosibirsk State University is an educational institution that hosts the Faculty of Information Technologies.

Faculty Of Information Technologies
The Faculty of Information Technologies is a department within Novosibirsk State University offering undergraduate programs in informatics and computer science.

Informatics And Computer Engineering
Informatics and Computer Engineering is an academic field of study offered as a bachelor's degree program at the Faculty of Information Technologies.

Software Engineering And Computer Science
Software Engineering and Computer Science is a specialized academic profile offered within the Informatics and Computer Engineering program.

Computer Science And System Engineering
Computer Science and System Engineering is a specialized academic profile offered within the Informatics and Computer Engineering program.

Akademgorodok
Akademgorodok is the location where NSU is situated, known for integrating study, science, and student life.

Dormitories
Dormitories are part of the NSU campus infrastructure provided for student accommodation.

Sports Facilities
Infrastructure including sports grounds, gyms, swimming pools, a ski base, and saunas available to students.

Student Resources
Student resources refer to the information provided to freshmen regarding health, safety, and student life.

Medical Services
Medical services are available for students to address health issues or emergencies.

Student Support Services
Resources provided to freshmen covering health, safety, and student life.
